title_zh: 用具体例子澄清草稿反馈的分歧

scenario.goal_zh: 提出可操作反馈并协商修订安排

context_zh: 两名同事讨论客户提案草稿的反馈，准备修改而非争论个人能力。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: You sounded very critical of my proposal in the meeting. Is there anything you think I should keep?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Yes, the customer examples are strong. My criticism was about the opening, not the whole document.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Then our disagreement may be smaller than I thought. I wanted readers to understand the background first.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: I understand. I don't want to criticize that aim, but they need to know what you're asking for before page three.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: Would a short request at the top help, with the background underneath?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Yes. Keep the examples, but move the one about delivery closer to the request.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.text: I'll revise the first two pages this afternoon. Could you read just those before I change the rest?

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Of course. I'll mark any sentence where the request still isn't clear.
